description: This file defines the 'InAccessibleEntityId' class, a validation rule for checking entity access permissions within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for validation, manages dependencies via traits, and interacts with repositories and role management.

classes.name: InAccessibleEntityId
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks whether a user has access to a specific entity ID, considering roles, permissions, and existence based on options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the entity name and optional access checking options.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the input to ensure entity accessibility, throwing exceptions or returning false as appropriate.
